import time

from typing import Any, Optional, Callable, Hashable
import pytest


class CacheEntry:
    """
    Represents a single entry in the cache.
    
    Attributes:
        key: The key of the cache entry
        value: The value associated with the key
        created_at: Timestamp when the entry was created
        accessed_at: Timestamp when the entry was last accessed
        ttl: Time to live in seconds (None for no expiry)
    """
    
    def __init__(self, key: Hashable, value: Any, ttl: Optional[float] = None):
        """
        Initialize a cache entry.
        
        Args:
            key: The key for this cache entry
            value: The value to store
            ttl: Time to live in seconds. If None, entry never expires.
        """
        self.key = key
        self.value = value
        self.created_at = time.time()
        self.accessed_at = self.created_at
        self.ttl = ttl
    
    def is_expired(self) -> bool:
        """
        Check if this cache entry has expired.
        
        Returns:
            True if the entry has expired, False otherwise
        """
        if self.ttl is None:
            return False
        return time.time() > self.created_at + self.ttl
    
    def touch(self) -> None:
        """Update the last accessed timestamp."""
        self.accessed_at = time.time()
    
    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        """Return a string representation of the cache entry."""
        ttl_info = f"ttl={self.ttl}s" if self.ttl is not None else "ttl=∞"
        return f"CacheEntry(key={self.key!r}, value={self.value!r}, {ttl_info})"
